messages:
nora: heads-up: sample-app CI failing typechecks after sdk bump. pyright complains about streaming return annotations and mypy marks model fields as Any. only started after the generator update.

ben: can you paste an example error?

nora: pyright: `Expression of type 'list[Item] | None' is not iterable` on `for it in resp.items:`. mypy: `error: Incompatible types (expression has type "Any", variable has type "Item")` when building list from resp parsing.

rio: probably the generator started emitting PEP 604 unions (`list[Foo] | None`). that's valid for py3.10 but breaks consumers on 3.8/3.9 or strict checker setups. also pydantic classes at runtime don't provide stubs, so static checkers see Any.

ben: options: (A) emit .pyi stubs next to generated modules (CLI flag e.g. `--emit-pyi`), (B) ship a small separate typings package `redwood-sdk-types`, or (C) hack generator to always emit `typing.List/Optional` instead of builtin generics.

nora: I'd prefer .pyi in-wheel. less packaging overhead and clients get types immediately after pip install.

rio: +1. if we go .pyi we should target py3.8 typings (typing.List/Optional) to avoid the `list[]` vs `typing.List` mismatch. include `if TYPE_CHECKING:` imports for forward refs.

ben: streaming endpoints are trickier. runtime yields raw chunks; some callers parse them into model deltas. pyright fails because the signature is `AsyncIterator[Union[str, dict]]`. we can use overloads in pyi so that `stream(..., parse=True)` returns `AsyncIterator[ModelDelta]` at type-check time.

rio: example pyi pattern:
```python
from typing import AsyncIterator, overload
@overload
def stream_events(*args, parse: bool = False) -> AsyncIterator[bytes]: ...
@overload
def stream_events(*args, parse: bool = True) -> AsyncIterator[EventDelta]: ...
```

nora: sounds good. also add `py.typed` and a types smoke-test in sample-app CI (run both pyright and mypy on a small example) so we don't regress.

ben: FYI edge-case: circular models and forward refs. pyi should use stringified refs like `List["Foo"]`. mypy sometimes still gripes; we should normalise codegen to emit `from typing import List, Optional` at top and use those for everything.

build-bot: build failed: sample-app/ci (branch: nora/pyi-stubs) - pyright error. https://ci.redwood.example/build/1247

rio: I'll hack a small emitter patch that adds `--emit-pyi` and formats stubs for py3.8+. nora can add the sample-app test. Ben can review the overload shape for streaming.

nora: opening draft PR in a few hours. thanks all :pray:
